todos: [P1] DOC-EXCEL-EXTRACTION-01: Audit F01. Restore XLSX/XLS extraction with declared, bundled parser engines. Reject parsing failure or headings-only output before indexing and preserve source files. Done when genuine XLSX/XLS fixtures retain expected cell values in development and the packaged Sidecar, and missing-engine/corrupt/empty input fails explicitly. Dependency changes require npm 11 where applicable and the native Python constraints/packaging workflow. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md. Session handoff 2026-10-01: critical audit and prioritized backlog are complete; all 46 implementation/qualification tasks remain open. Read the Session handoff section in docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md before continuing; this is the first implementation task. Product hardware requirements are independent of the user's PC.

[P1] DOC-PARQUET-EXTRACTION-01: Audit F02. Implement Parquet extraction with the existing pandas/Arrow stack or explicitly reject it as unsupported throughout classification and ingestion. Done when a genuine Parquet fixture preserves expected values, and invalid/unsupported input cannot be reported as successfully indexed. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] DOC-NORMALIZATION-INTEGRITY-01: Audit F03. Reject truncated/incomplete LLM normalization, omitted source entities and unjustified content replacement. Preserve the original extracted text and expose a review-required outcome instead of successful normalization. Done when done_reason=length, removed numbers/references, missing clauses and valid cleanup cases are distinguished; deterministic checks must not claim universal semantic equivalence. Keep current retries, budgets and timeouts. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] CHAT-GROUNDING-FAILURE-01: Audit F10. Carry search/document-loading failure and partial availability into visible chat state. Do not convert a failed load to empty full-document content or tell the model it has access when it does not. Done when unavailable, partial, deleted and successfully loaded selections have distinct truthful behavior and no apparently grounded answer is generated after grounding failure. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] CHAT-OPERATION-CANCELLATION-01: Audit F25. Use one chat run identity from preparation through retrieval, document loading, queueing, streaming and persistence. First reproduce Stop/conversation-switch races with controlled delayed operations, then prevent stale completions or a generation starting after cancellation. Done when delayed retrieval, queue cancellation and conversation changes cannot mutate or persist another run's messages. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] RAG-EMBEDDING-DIMENSIONS-01: Audit F05. Replace generic 768-dimensional coercion with validated model-specific native dimensions or documented MRL reduction plus normalization. Reject malformed vectors instead of masking them through padding. Version encoder/dimension policy and design backup, readback, rollback and explicit reindexing before any persisted-vector migration; recover document-recovery.json first. Done when supported encoders preserve the intended geometry and incompatible stores are handled explicitly without mixing spaces. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] RAG-EMBEDDING-TASK-PREPARATION-01: Audit F06. Prepare document and query embeddings according to each encoder's official task instructions, including Nomic search_document/search_query prefixes and Qwen query instructions where applicable. Persist preparation-policy provenance and plan explicit backed-up reindexing. Done when captured requests prove the correct role/prefix and Italian/English retrieval is evaluated with the matching policy. Depends on: RAG-EMBEDDING-DIMENSIONS-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01: Audit F07. Add an independent local FTS/BM25 candidate path before RRF, using database-native facilities and preserving document filters. Done when exact codes/names/clauses outside the dense shortlist can enter results, and dense, lexical and fused ranks remain traceable; do not invent a new lexical parser. Depends on: RAG-EMBEDDING-DIMENSIONS-01, RAG-EMBEDDING-TASK-PREPARATION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] RAG-EVIDENCE-SCORING-01: Audit F09. Separate heuristic ranking scores from calibrated relevance/evidence confidence. Replace the unsupported percentage claim and define evaluated insufficient-evidence/abstention behavior without excluding valid cross-language or paraphrased passages solely for zero term overlap. Done when absent-answer and unrelated-candidate cases are handled truthfully and displayed values match their documented meaning. Depends on: RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] RAG-CLAIM-SOURCE-PROVENANCE-01: Audit F11. Carry stable source identity and original page/section/span provenance through retrieval and navigable chat citations. Distinguish retrieved candidates from evidence cited for actual answer claims; validate source references and retain the original document. Review non-trivial IPC/REST/schema changes before implementation. Done when an answer claim opens its supporting original location and invalid or uncited references cannot appear as verified support. Depends on: CHAT-GROUNDING-FAILURE-01, RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] MODEL-QUALIFICATION-SIGNALS-01: Audit F14, F16. Separate installed/runtime compatibility, native tool support, focused probe success and full-task qualification in badges, preflight and product wording. Account for the effective run context rather than advertised capacity alone. Keep autonomous coding explicitly experimental/unqualified while complete acceptance is missing. Done when the incomplete 7B and 9B evidence cannot produce a blanket verified-agent claim; retain the full evidence tooltip. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] MODEL-RUNTIME-FIT-01: Audit F18. Evaluate fit from model metadata, actual quantization, effective context, cache/runtime configuration and measured allocations instead of one fixed architecture and 4K-only badges. Distinguish supported CPU offload from GPU residency and adequate memory from acceptable speed. Done when setup, selectors and execution agree for declared workload/context, uncertainty is visible and no existing memory/OOM safeguards are weakened. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] MODEL-TASK-QUALITY-BASELINES-01: Audit F17, F18. Define open local model suites by task quality and declared product hardware, independently of the development PC. Candidate document baseline: Qwen3.5 9B plus Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B and native RapidOCR, with 32 GB RAM/12 GB supported GPU VRAM as a target to qualify. Stronger document and coding candidates include Qwen3.5 27B and Qwen3-Coder 30B on appropriately larger memory/context. Record tag, digest, quantization and license; small models get explicit limitations. Do not silently overwrite saved settings, install models or label proposed hardware as certified. Depends on: MODEL-QUALIFICATION-SIGNALS-01, MODEL-RUNTIME-FIT-01, RAG-EMBEDDING-DIMENSIONS-01, RAG-EMBEDDING-TASK-PREPARATION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] AGENT-PLAN-COVERAGE-SEMANTICS-01: qwen3.5:9b thinking diagnosis exhausted all 10 authorized attempts. Global constraints are still falsely covered by local criteria (original lines 23/25). Scope-field prototype regressed correct-plan acceptance and was removed; indexed fail-closed review and two-candidate budget remain. Preserve minimal-global-scope-case.json and all thinking/wire evidence under attempt-10 OnlyRag-Live campaign. No further same-problem attempts without a new strategy authorization. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md. Session handoff 2026-10-01: read the Session handoff section in docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md before resuming. The last verified baseline is 288 files / 2335 tests and all eight supplemental live cases; do not rerun completed diagnoses or claim TaskLab qualified. Audit F15 follow-up: Define a new review strategy that distinguishes global constraints from local criteria and measures false acceptance, false rejection and planning latency on retained independent cases. Preserve fail-closed review, traceable evidence and the two-candidate limit. Existing ten-attempt diagnosis remains exhausted; tracking this task does not authorize an eleventh same-strategy attempt. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] TRANSLATION-FIDELITY-LIVE-01: OCR numeric-type failure, damaged instruction extraction, signature erasure and silent text/entity loss are fixed. Verified baseline: 176 Sidecar tests, 288 files / 2335 frontend tests, build and static checks pass. The real scanned PDF was regenerated with qwen3.5:9b, think=false, num_ctx=32768; source and previous output hashes are unchanged. Remaining: expand postal a.r. into English, qualify semantic fidelity on additional documents, and verify the restarted desktop UI path. The thinking probe exceeded both existing 120-second attempts; keep retries/timeouts unchanged. Saved settings still select llama3.2:3b; the user authorized trying 9B without changing settings. Read Session handoff in docs/translation-fidelity-2026-10-01.md before resuming; preserve evidence and PDFs under OnlyRag-Live/translation-fidelity-20261001-95fd936f and Downloads/OnlyRag-translation-20261001-95fd936f. Do not treat successful export as proof of semantic equivalence. Audit F19 follow-up: Expand complete source/output comparisons across documents and languages, including omissions, negations, alternatives, conditions, deadlines, names and delivery terminology; verify the restarted desktop path. Record model-specific suitability and thinking behavior without increasing existing retries/timeouts or treating entity/rendering checks as semantic proof. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] QUALITY-CONTENT-ACCEPTANCE-01: Audit F30. Create a fixed representative Italian/English corpus and independent quality acceptance for extraction, normalization, exact-code/paraphrase/cross-language retrieval, tables, late pages, contradictions, absent answers and claim/source support. Report recall/ranking and supported-answer outcomes separately from deterministic mocked mechanics. Freeze expected evidence and record failures honestly; define critical-path coverage needs rather than inflate overall test counts. Depends on: DOC-EXCEL-EXTRACTION-01, DOC-PARQUET-EXTRACTION-01, DOC-NORMALIZATION-INTEGRITY-01, CHAT-GROUNDING-FAILURE-01, RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01, RAG-CLAIM-SOURCE-PROVENANCE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] LOCAL-MODEL-ROLE-QUALIFICATION-01: Audit F17, F18, F19, F30. Measure the proposed product profiles on adequate hardware for document chat, translation, native OCR and optional Vision, with exact model/runtime provenance and independent content-quality checks. Record hot/cold first-output latency, sustained throughput, effective context, RAM/VRAM and corpus-size retrieval latency; suggested audit thresholds remain proposed until established. Certify only roles/configurations that pass. This future campaign must respect existing live-model scope; it does not resume deferred agent work or change personal settings. Depends on: MODEL-TASK-QUALITY-BASELINES-01, QUALITY-CONTENT-ACCEPTANCE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] LIVE-MODEL-HARDWARE-01: TaskLab qualification remains OPEN on qwen3.5:9b only, thinking enabled, initial context 16384. Three scaffold attempts failed; 0 complete sequences and 0 qualified stages. Prompt 1.2.0 has 16 stages, independent build/tests and browser checks at 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920 px. Resume two independent sequences after the semantic prerequisite is resolved. The canonical behavioral gate fix passes regressions but its live confirmation was blocked at planning. Original full-task benchmark stays separate; preserve all failed workspaces, snapshots and Desktop/test_app. Eight supplemental live assertions now pass in one replay, including native test-command proof, filesystem rollback and ordinary denial recovery. These declared fixtures do not qualify TaskLab. Evidence and 37-tool/26-area matrix: docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md. Audit F14, F30 follow-up: Keep the current bounded 9B campaign and original benchmark separate. Complete the two independent TaskLab sequences only after the semantic prerequisite is resolved, using frozen independent tests/builds and required rendered-app checks; report complete task outcomes, not merely valid tool calls. Proposed stronger-model qualification remains a separate future scope decision, with no restart of retained deferred work. Depends on: AGENT-PLAN-COVERAGE-SEMANTICS-01, MODEL-QUALIFICATION-SIGNALS-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P1] DISTRIBUTION-LICENSE-POLICY-01: Audit F32. Inventory bundled dependency and model licenses and document the applicable PyMuPDF/MuPDF AGPL-compliant or commercial licensing route, notices and corresponding-source obligations before public distribution. Check evidence of any existing commercial grant without logging credentials. Done when the chosen distribution policy and notices are explicit and reviewed; do not assert noncompliance merely from the top-level MIT declaration. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] DOC-NORMALIZATION-CONTEXT-01: Audit F04. Give normalization and OCR context controls explicit consistent semantics; propagate the intended effective context to the normalizer through the existing workflow and make output budgeting explicit. Done when captured normalization requests match configured role/context and input/output limits are respected without raising application retries/timeouts. Depends on: DOC-NORMALIZATION-INTEGRITY-01, MODEL-RUNTIME-FIT-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] RAG-STRUCTURE-AWARE-CHUNKING-01: Audit F21. Replace the universal oversized-section split with bounded task/model-aware chunks that preserve table headers/rows, code blocks, clause context and page provenance. Use existing parsing facilities. Done when representative structured documents retain interpretable chunks and measured retrieval quality does not regress; size/overlap changes require explicit backed-up reindexing. Depends on: RAG-EMBEDDING-DIMENSIONS-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] CHAT-DOCUMENT-COVERAGE-01: Audit F12. Choose full-context, focused retrieval or complete-document processing according to task and available context instead of always adding document beginnings to a shortlist. Show actual coverage/truncation and support complete summaries/comparisons through bounded processing. Done when late sections and multi-document coverage are evaluated and unavailable portions are not described as fully visible. Depends on: CHAT-GROUNDING-FAILURE-01, RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01, RAG-CLAIM-SOURCE-PROVENANCE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] CHAT-EFFECTIVE-CONTEXT-ALLOCATION-01: Audit F13. Allocate document and history budgets from the effective model window and task, reserving output space; a larger selected context must not leave arbitrary tier character caps silently unchanged. Done when small/large windows use truthful bounded allocations, retain required instructions and never exceed the runtime memory/context budget. Depends on: MODEL-RUNTIME-FIT-01, CHAT-DOCUMENT-COVERAGE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] RAG-SEMANTIC-RERANKER-QUALIFICATION-01: Audit F08. Name the current lexical heuristic accurately and compare it with an optional local learned reranker on the frozen multilingual corpus. Consider Qwen3-Reranker 0.6B as an unqualified candidate; measure quality, latency and peak memory before selecting a default. Done when the chosen path has a documented measurable benefit or the optional path is explicitly rejected. New dependencies require review. Depends on: RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01, QUALITY-CONTENT-ACCEPTANCE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] TABULAR-BOUNDED-READ-INTEGRITY-01: Audit F20. Bound/stream CSV and supported spreadsheet parsing before materializing full tables, and expose skipped malformed rows, sheet/row limits and truncation. Done when large input has measured bounded memory and malformed or omitted rows cannot disappear without an explicit result; preserve parser correctness and existing source files. Depends on: DOC-EXCEL-EXTRACTION-01, DOC-PARQUET-EXTRACTION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] RAG-INDEX-METADATA-EFFICIENCY-01: Audit F20. Measure search/indexing on declared corpus sizes, remove repeated full embedding-model metadata scans using database-native facilities, and create native vector/FTS indexes when measurements justify them. Done when filter correctness and retrieval quality remain stable and p95 latency/peak memory improve on recorded workloads; do not add an index abstraction without a real boundary. Depends on: RAG-INDEPENDENT-LEXICAL-RETRIEVAL-01, QUALITY-CONTENT-ACCEPTANCE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] OLLAMA-RESOURCE-ADMISSION-01: Audit F22. Coordinate Main and Sidecar model workload admission and resource accounting across chat, coding, embeddings, translation and Vision. Measure concurrent requests, three-worker page processing and per-page cold loads before choosing a bounded keep-alive/admission policy. Done when queue/cancel behavior and peak memory are predictable under declared workloads and existing locks, budgets, timeouts and OOM safeguards remain enforced. Depends on: MODEL-RUNTIME-FIT-01, CHAT-OPERATION-CANCELLATION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] HISTORY-EMBEDDING-CORRECTNESS-01: Audit F23. Correct the squared-L2-to-cosine transformation and store encoder/preparation/fallback provenance for semantic prompt history. Never compare incompatible hash/model spaces. Done when a cosine-0.75 fixture reports 0.75, fallback/recovery remains space-consistent and legacy history has a backed-up verified migration or explicit reindex path. Depends on: RAG-EMBEDDING-DIMENSIONS-01, RAG-EMBEDDING-TASK-PREPARATION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] SETTINGS-PERSISTENCE-FEEDBACK-01: Audit F28. Expose saving, saved and failed/unsaved states with a practical retry path. Preserve serialized writes and original-file protection. Done when a failed save is visible, the UI cannot imply durable success and retry/restart readback confirms the intended settings. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] MODAL-FOCUS-ACCESSIBILITY-01: Audit F27. Implement focus containment, inert background, previous-focus restoration and topmost-only Escape handling for shared/nested modals. Done when keyboard and assistive-technology checks cover opening, navigation, dismissal and nested approval dialogs without bypassing required approval. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] CHAT-READABLE-OUTPUT-01: Audit F26. Render safe, readable Markdown tables/lists/links/code and improve source-card text size/navigation. Measure long-history rendering before adding virtualization. Done when representative answers and evidence are usable at supported desktop sizes/zoom, external links retain navigation safety and long chats have recorded responsiveness rather than speculative optimization. Depends on: RAG-CLAIM-SOURCE-PROVENANCE-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] UX-FIRST-USE-SIMPLIFICATION-01: Audit F29, F17. Reduce the path to the first useful document answer: one adequate general model, one encoder and native OCR by default, with advanced roles/controls progressively disclosed. Review medical/legal substring-routing labels and require explicit domain qualification rather than implying semantic expertise. Done when documented first-use tasks require fewer decisions and all existing advanced capabilities/safety controls remain accessible unless a product-contract change is explicitly approved. Depends on: MODEL-TASK-QUALITY-BASELINES-01, CHAT-DOCUMENT-COVERAGE-01, MODEL-QUALIFICATION-SIGNALS-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] CODE-FOCUSED-RESPONSIBILITIES-01: Audit F29, F30. Identify concrete maintenance hotspots in large UI/state/orchestration modules and simplify only measured, relevant responsibilities with preserved behavior and native checks. Remove dead symbols/debug or obsolete comments on contact; keep comments concise, practical and truthful about lexical versus semantic behavior. Done when the selected hotspots have clearer ownership without duplicate implementations, speculative layers or removed safeguards. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] CHAT-DURABLE-HISTORY-01: Audit F24. Design bounded/incremental durable chat persistence with backup/export and recovery instead of whole-history synchronous localStorage writes. Review the persisted-format boundary before implementation, preserve legacy conversations and verify backup/readback/rollback. Done when large-history/quota/crash cases remain recoverable and only changed records need persistence; no destructive legacy cleanup. Depends on: CHAT-OPERATION-CANCELLATION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] QUALITY-PYTHON-CRITICAL-PATHS-01: Audit F30. Select and introduce scoped Python lint/type analysis using the native dependency/CI workflow, and define meaningful critical-path branch checks alongside existing pytest. Assess the existing coverage exclusions/floors without blanket threshold increases or disabling rules. Done when checks detect relevant defects, existing verified behavior passes and fixture mechanics are clearly distinguished from semantic qualification. New tools/dependencies require review. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] AGENT-SESSION-LIVE-01: Matching-run interrupted resume, full checkpoint restoration, session isolation, serial queue and real context compaction remain live qualification limits. Real 9B concurrent-edit rejection/reread/recovery now passes with frozen independent tests and preserves the injected collaborator line; per-step rollback also passes. Deterministic tests and Electron restore/queue scenarios pass; TaskLab's final resumed stage has not executed. Preserve verified evidence and explicit decisions without changing user data. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md. Audit F30 follow-up: Complete isolated interruption/resume, checkpoint restoration, session isolation, queue and real compaction qualification against preserved state, with independent assertions; targeted rollback/concurrent-edit successes remain qualified only for their exercised scenarios. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] AGENT-SKILLS-LIVE-01: Real 9B skill selection and adherence remain unqualified. Matcher and active-skill policy regressions pass; isolated campaigns do not inherit or alter personal skills. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md. Audit F30 follow-up: Qualify real-model skill selection and adherence in isolated campaigns with frozen expected behavior; do not modify or inherit personal skills as fixtures. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] AGENT-NETWORK-LIVE-01: Public search, fetch and download availability/provenance remain explicit live limits. Deterministic consent, SSRF and download tests pass; local Ollama traffic and approved package installs do not qualify these tools. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md. Audit F30 follow-up: Qualify actual public-tool availability/provenance within the existing consent, SSRF and local-only inference boundaries; mocked responses and package installs remain separate evidence. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] AGENT-OOM-LIVE-01: Real OOM handling and owned-resource closure remain unverified; no OOM was induced. Preserve memory/time/loop safeguards and require isolated evidence before claiming this area covered. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-10-01.md. Audit F30, F22 follow-up: Verify existing OOM handling and closure of owned resources in an isolated controlled campaign with independent process identity evidence; never reclaim unrelated processes/ports or loosen memory safeguards. Depends on: OLLAMA-RESOURCE-ADMISSION-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] AGENT-THINKING-RUNAWAY-01: Confirm the implemented 18-minute reasoning cut on a real thinking-model run that crosses the budget; retain transport tests and the two-cut termination guard. Thinking-off runs do not verify this behavior. Audit F30 follow-up: Keep the real threshold-crossing qualification distinct from normal reasoning latency and thinking-off probes; preserve the eighteen-minute cut, existing transport budgets and two-cut termination guard. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: Deferred by user scope on 2026-10-01. No live models other than qwen3.5:9b; do not resume the interrupted 27B workspace. Retain historical transport-timeout and CPU-heavy failure evidence for future stronger-model qualification. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] I18N-SIDECAR-MIGRATION-LIVE-01: Isolated nonempty migration and backup rollback passed; actual app userData had no legacy chunks. Confirm on the first real nonempty legacy corpus. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] LEGACY-SESSION-COMPAT-01: Keep identity-free plan seeds and fallback-session migration until a released version has migrated real nonempty legacy data with verified backup/readback. Then inventory registered workspaces and both fallback stores again; preserve the 21 dev state files pending provenance review. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] LIVE-RUN-RESIDUE-CLEANUP-01: Preserve failed-run workspaces, profiles and snapshots until diagnosis is complete. Remove only known test residues when policy permits, protecting app userData, Ollama models and the OnlyRag-Live root. Exact retained paths and prior approval failures: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] DISTRIBUTION-PACKAGE-SIZE-01: Audit F31. Measure the installer/installed footprint and bundled CUDA/native assets, then evaluate a smaller baseline or optional acceleration distribution. Done when the chosen packaging reduces measured size without losing native OCR/offline startup or licensed resources; review packaging-contract changes first and preserve the accepted unsigned-distribution policy. Depends on: LOCAL-MODEL-ROLE-QUALIFICATION-01, DISTRIBUTION-LICENSE-POLICY-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.

[P3] DISTRIBUTION-UPDATE-PATH-01: Audit F31. Define a clear supported manual update/rollback path first; evaluate an updater only if justified. Preserve settings, documents, sessions and recovery journals during upgrades. Done when packaged upgrade/readback/rollback is demonstrated and published version/update expectations are documented; no publishing, signing change or deployment is authorized by task tracking. Depends on: DISTRIBUTION-LICENSE-POLICY-01. Evidence: docs/critical-app-audit-2026-10-01.md.
